Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed by National Highways Authority of India today, is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Saurabh Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri Pranjal Mehrotra,
learned counsel for the NHAI and Sri Suresh Singh, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State.

3. Challenge has been raised to the award dated 22.12.2022, framed by the respondent no. 4, Special Land Acquisition Officer, Prayagraj, insofar as by that award the compensation has been fixed qua land belonging to the petitioners in defiance of the mandatory provisions of Section 3G (3) read with Narendra Pratap Singh And 14 Others vs Union Of India And 5 Others on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33144653/
1 (4) of the National Highways Act, 1956.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. At present, it is not clear, if any land belonging to any of the 15 petitioners has been acquired as may have given rise to any cause of action to any of the petitioners.
5. In such circumstances, learned counsel for the petitioners prays for and is permitted to withdraw the present writ petition with liberty to file individual writ petitions disclosing full facts.
6. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed.

Order Date :- 16.8.2023 SA (Anish Kumar Gupta, J.) (S.D. Singh, J.)
